text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I mean, they did tell me to tune in, but I 
never expected a whole "Happy Birthday 
Stream" to start!

text_block_list.name: Loves in the Video
text_block_list.text:
"Today we'll be making and delivering a 
birthday cake for Yanko-san on stream♡"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I couldn't stop grinning until it 
was delivered to my room~♪ By the way, 
wasn't there a pastry chef in the 
comments?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Fufufu, Love-chan's fan community is full 
of experts from all kinds of fields, you 
know!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep♪ Like journalists, manga 
artists... and even staff from virtual 
talent agencies♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the pastry chef, I'm so glad we 
were able to make such a wonderful cake 
this time♡

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Whew♪ Nice, connections are pure treasure. 
Throw trust into the mix and you're 
seriously unstoppable.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Yep, yep, totally! That supreme trust♪ 
The unbreakable bond of the fan 
community!"

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Nice~! That's the ultimate partnership 
right there. Honestly, I'm kinda jealous♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ But I think Yan-ko-san and our trust 
is completely solid too♡

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Thanks☆ ...Hey, in that case, why don't we 
put both our connections to full use and 
start something fun?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
For instance... maybe we could have my 
family's media branch make a special 
feature program on the fan community♪ 
Let's brainstorm it properly over some 
cake☆
